command:
sh -c '
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"  # non-login SSH shells on RHEL 7 lack sbin
sec(){ printf '"'"'\n@@%s@@\n'"'"' "$1"; }
sec sshd_t; sh -c '"'"'sshd -T 2>&1'"'"' kanareika  | grep -Ei '"'"'^(port|permitrootlogin|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|pubkeyauthentication|authorizedkeysfile|usepam|permitemptypasswords|allowusers|allowgroups|denyusers|listenaddress|maxauthtries) |denied|not permitted|error'"'"'
sec sshd_files; cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '"'"'^\s*(Port|PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication|KbdInteractiveAuthentication|ChallengeResponseAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|AuthorizedKeysFile|UsePAM|PermitEmptyPasswords|AllowUsers|AllowGroups)\s'"'"'
sec passwd; awk -F: '"'"'{print $1":"$3":"$6":"$7}'"'"' /etc/passwd
sec sshd_users; for u in $(awk -F: '"'"'$7 !~ /(nologin|false|sync|shutdown|halt)$/ && $1 ~ /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]*$/ {print $1}'"'"' /etc/passwd | head -n 30); do echo "U:$u"; sh -c '"'"'sshd -T -C "user=$1,host=kanareika-probe,addr=203.0.113.10" 2>&1 | grep -Ei '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'^(passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|usepam) '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"''"'"' kanareika  "$u"; done
sec shadow_pw; sh -c '"'"'awk -F: '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'($2 != "" && $2 !~ /^[!*]/) {print "PW:"$1}'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' /etc/shadow'"'"' kanareika  2>&1
sec keys; sh -c '"'"'awk -F: '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'{print $1" "$6}'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' /etc/passwd | while read u h; do for f in "$h/.ssh/authorized_keys" "$h/.ssh/authorized_keys2"; do [ -f "$f" ] && sed "s|^|K:$u:$f:|" "$f"; done; done 2>/dev/null'"'"' kanareika 
sec auth; sh -c '"'"'{ journalctl -u sshd -u ssh --since -30d -o short-iso --no-pager -q 2>/dev/null; for f in $(ls -1tr /var/log/secure /var/log/secure.1 /var/log/secure-[0-9]* /var/log/auth.log /var/log/auth.log.1 2>/dev/null | grep -v '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'\.gz$'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'); do cat "$f"; done; } | grep -E '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'sshd\[[0-9]+\]: (Accepted |Failed |Invalid user )'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' | tail -n 150000; echo @@auth-readable@@'"'"' kanareika 
sec last; last -F -w -n 200 2>/dev/null | head -n 200
'
